name: BIG THREE
description: Big Three (大三, Da San) is a strategic Chinese climbing game for 3 players from the Shaanxi province. It is closely related to games like 'Wa Keng' (Digging the Pit). In each deal, the 3s are the highest-ranking cards, and players bid in an auction to become the 'Declarer' who plays alone against the other two. The game is known for its peculiar ranking (3s high, 2s second) and the restriction that 3s, 2s, and Aces cannot be used in sequences.

content.text: Big Three (大三, Da San) is a strategic Chinese climbing game for 3 players from the Shaanxi province. It is closely related to games like 'Wa Keng' (Digging the Pit). In each deal, the 3s are the highest-ranking cards, and players bid in an auction to become the 'Declarer' who plays alone against the other two. The game is known for its peculiar ranking (3s high, 2s second) and the restriction that 3s, 2s, and Aces cannot be used in sequences.

Originating in Shaanxi province, China, as a variation of the broader 'climbing' genre. It specifically targets three-player dynamics, making it a faster and more aggressive alternative to the four-player 'Tractor' family.
The deck is dealt as follows: 16 cards to each player and 4 cards face down in the center (The Widow).

items.text: Wa Keng (Digging the Pit): Essentially the same game, but with different scoring multipliers for specific 'bombs'.
